instruction: Stream the latest episode of 'The Mandalorian' from your Disney+ subscription using VLC media player.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Disney+ uses DRM (Digital Rights Management) protection that prevents playback in VLC. Disney+ content requires proprietary DRM implementations (Widevine/PlayReady) that VLC does not support.
